text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Constitution of the Federal Court               '
Order 2005.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 2 June 2005.

Number of other judges of the Federal Court

2. The number of the other judges of the Federal Court shall be eight.

Revocation

3. The Constitution of the Federal Court (Judges) Order 1982 which is published
in P.U. (A) 114 on 29 April 1982 is revoked.

Made 9 June 2005
[PM(BK)R. 11030/8 Jld. 5; PN(PU?)1714/II)

By Command

TAN Sri SAMSUDIN BIN OSMAN
Secretary to the Cabinet
